limitations: S5/S6 and A1/A2 block numerical evidence are separately audited by the block agent; this audit covers the other manuscript quantitative content plus all original 95 cell counts/intervals/timings and registered inferential summaries.
Public-source dates/version availability and bibliographic content are handled by the root source verification; this audit checks record-bound acquisition identities and document consistency.
This audit does not infer callback attribution, physical-fault timing, power-fault guarantees, or a default-browser rollout from the observations.
Archive receipts and exact-package public deposit limitations must remain disclosed until separately verified; core raw record reproduction is not full remote archive verification.
Embedded figure bytes match the reviewed builder outputs; cell counts and interval inputs are compared independently, without claiming OCR of every pixel label.
